# dsh-web-design
English | 中文
## What problem does it solve?
AI-generated prototype pages often include descriptions and sections you never asked for. Removing t
hem can take repeated back-and-forth with the AI.
This DeepSeek Harness plugin lets you delete sections and edit text directly in the HTML preview, ad
just styles and positions, and save the changes to the HTML file—without asking the AI to make each
yles and positions, and save the changes to the HTML file—without asking the AI to make each change.
In the plugin list, display names and descriptions follow the Harness language setting in English or
Chinese (English is the default fallback); English names use the package name without its npm scope
, Chinese names describe the purpose, and installation still uses the unchanged real package name.

## Notes
- The HTML source changes only when you click **Save to file**. Preview edits are stored in `<filena

me>.design.json` beside the HTML file until then.
- To change text, select the specific text element

. Elements with multiple direct text runs cannot be replaced directly.
- Elements generated by scrip
ts or not uniquely locatable in the source are skipped when saving. Use unique, stable `id` values f

or editable elements and check the result after saving.
- Relative CSS, JavaScript, image, and font
references may not load in the preview. Single-file prototypes with inline styles and scripts are re
may not load in the preview. Single-file prototypes with inline styles and scripts are recommended.
